cases.case_label: Homozygous mobile element insertion in FERMT1 (Kindler syndrome)
cases.mechanism_detail: A homozygous mobile element insertion detected by MELT in exome data in FERMT1; an RNA study confirmed a pathological effect on splicing. The element type and splicing outcome are not specified in the abstract.
cases.quote: A homozygous insertion was identified in the FERMT1 gene involved in Kindler syndrome. RNA study confirmed its pathological impact on splicing.

cases.case_label: De novo Alu insertion in GRIN2B (developmental disorder)
cases.mechanism_detail: A de novo Alu insertion in GRIN2B was found by MELT in exome data of a patient with a developmental disorder; the abstract does not describe its location within the gene or its molecular effect.
cases.quote: The second ME was a de novo Alu insertion in the GRIN2B gene involved in intellectual disability, and detected in a patient with a developmental disorder.
